question: If A = (36div 18times 5)/(36 div(3times 4)) and B = (5div 15times 5+6times 2-5)/(15div 5×25-2×3+6), then what is the value of (A + B)?
solution:
Given:

 A = (36div 18times 5)/(36 div(3times 4)) and B=(5div 15times 5+6times 2-5)/(15div 5×25-2×3+6) [IMAGE: data:image/gif;base64,R0lGODlhAQABAPABAP///wAAACH5BAEKAAAALAAAAAABAAEAAAICRAEAOw==] 

Concept used:

Follow the BODMAS rule to solve this question, as per the order given below,

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/03b57550ab0ec22377cb69f9d9968b9e7eaf8cdda2ac1a966b0738bbea54f43d.png] 

Calculation:

A = (36div 18times 5)/(36 div(3times 4))

A = (2times 5)/(36÷12)

A = (10)/(3)

B=(5div 15times 5+6times 2-5)/(15div 5×25-2×3+6)

B=(frac{5)/(3)+12-5}{75-+6+6}

B=(frac{5+36-15)/(3)}{75}

B=(26)/(225)

⇒ A + B

⇒ 10/3 + 26/225

⇒ (750 + 26)/225

⇒ 776/225

**∴ Option 1 is the correct answer.**
